# limit/nresults (RFC 6578 3.6/3.7): more changes than the limit give the
# first ones, a 507 for the collection with number-of-matches-within-
# limits and a token that goes on right after them.
@seed calendar privat a.ics weekly-team.ics

> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token/><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:prop><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 207
< save token sync-token

# Three changes elsewhere, then limit 1.
@seed calendar privat b.ics dentist.ics
@seed calendar privat c.ics running.ics
@delete calendar privat a.ics

> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token>{saved:token}</A:sync-token><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:limit><A:nresults>1</A:nresults></A:limit><A:prop><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 207
< responses 2
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/b.ics d:getetag {etag:dentist.ics}
< response /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/ 507
< response-error /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/ d:number-of-matches-within-limits
< sync-token-not {saved:token}
< save page1 sync-token

> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token>{saved:page1}</A:sync-token><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:limit><A:nresults>1</A:nresults></A:limit><A:prop><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 207
< responses 2
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/c.ics d:getetag {etag:running.ics}
< response /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/ 507
< save page2 sync-token

# The rest without a limit; then nothing is left.
> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token>{saved:page2}</A:sync-token><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:prop><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 207
< responses 1
< response /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/a.ics 404
< save done sync-token

> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token>{saved:done}</A:sync-token><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:limit><A:nresults>1</A:nresults></A:limit><A:prop><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 207
< responses 0
< sync-token-is {saved:done}

# The first listing in pages (RFC 6578 3.11): by name, the token goes on
# after the last name given.
> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token/><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:limit><A:nresults>1</A:nresults></A:limit><A:prop><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 207
< responses 2
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/b.ics d:getetag {etag:dentist.ics}
< response /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/ 507
< save first sync-token

> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token>{saved:first}</A:sync-token><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:limit><A:nresults>5</A:nresults></A:limit><A:prop><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 207
< responses 1
< value /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/c.ics d:getetag {etag:running.ics}
< sync-token-is {saved:done}

# A limit that is no positive number is 400; one over 1000 is taken as 1000.
> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token/><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:limit><A:nresults>0</A:nresults></A:limit><A:prop><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 400

> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token/><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:limit><A:nresults>zehn</A:nresults></A:limit><A:prop><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 400

> REPORT /caldav/alex/calendars/privat/
> Auth: alex
>
> <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
> <A:sync-collection xmlns:A="DAV:"><A:sync-token/><A:sync-level>1</A:sync-level><A:limit><A:nresults>99999</A:nresults></A:limit><A:prop><A:getetag/></A:prop></A:sync-collection>
< status 207
< responses 2
